about.title: About Maverick Tree Service
text: Maverick Tree Service is a licensed and insured tree company that provides superior work for residential and commercial customers in Houston, TX since 2019. We offer complete and cost-effective tree removal services with top-class work and professionalism. We offer affordable services that are unmatched in the industry with our affordable rates, you can save money without sacrificing service character.

Our team members are highly trained to provide complete and comprehensive tree removal in a profitable manner services that do not compromise on quality. With over a decade of experience, we ensure that you get the greatest possible service from us every time. We are a team of highly skilled and experienced tree removal specialists and we deliver top-notch services that do not jeopardize quality.

Our company’s growth has been tremendous since our inception, but we continue to focus on providing local customers with value-added services at affordable prices. Our team members are available for emergency tree removal 24 hours a day, 7 days a week!
